what_this_is: the rule bank with every template BioTransformer's published set also contains removed, which is the bank this repository redistributes
why: BioTransformer's README requires explicit permission for redistribution and that permission has not been sought; one of its files is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, which no GPL release can carry. Neither is settleable here.
cost: zero references on the evaluated test set; every reference these templates reach is reached by another template in the bank, priced in results/licence_removal_cost__clean_test.json
not_identifiable_here: BioTransformer's environmental-microbial file contributes two further templates and its standardisation file none; the first is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and neither is held here, so those two templates remain in the released bank and are declared rather than removed
how_to_rebuild_the_measured_bank: obtain BioTransformer's reaction database from its own project and re-add every template of it that this bank contained; the measured bank's digest above confirms the result
